title: Evaluation of the normalized ordinary tower unit
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, Base b, a morphism f:X -> Y of schemes and Geometry g for f, as in def-sp-tower-shriek-data. For every coefficient index n and strict system M on Y, evaluating the unit of g.ordinaryAdjunction and composing with g.ordinaryPushEvaluation at g.pull(M), then with constant-ring pushforward of g.ordinaryPullEvaluation at M, equals the unit of the canonical constant-ring adjunction at M_n. This is an equation in the ordinary category of modules over B_n(Y), for arbitrary f; it asserts no localization, exactness or preservation of colimits.

source.place: paragraph (2), ordinary counit-unit exact sequence before passage to complexes

proof.text: In the proved private transport_unit_evaluation helper, abstract the target coefficient family, transitions, system pull/push functors, ordinary adjunction, dependent package of the level pull/push functors and adjunction, and ordinary evaluation comparisons. Eliminate the coefficient equality, then the transition HEq, then the system functor and adjunction HEqs. Eliminate the equality of dependent level packages, and finally the two comparison HEqs. The generic unit equation is now definitionally the required fixed-coordinate equation.

Apply transport_unit_evaluation with the actual generic data and the normalization fields of g. Its equation input is g.generic.ordinary_unit_evaluation n M, a field of the existing generic Geometry interface. No existence theorem or derived comparison is used. Equality elimination works uniformly at n=0 and for empty schemes and zero systems.

lean.statement:
theorem geometry_unit_evaluation (b : Base l E)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (g : Geometry l E b f) (n : ℕ) (M : S l E Y) :
    (ev l E Y n).map (g.ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app M) ≫
      (g.ordinaryPushEvaluation n).hom.app (g.pull.obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantRingPushforward (R l E n) f).map
        ((g.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).hom.app M) =
      (proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (R l E n) f).unit.app ((ev l E Y n).obj M)
